Thanks to Foxgear’s pioneering distortion circuit “DynaFET™” made of multi-stage Class A FET, the Sinister is capable of reaching an insane amount of gain. Yet, it can keep tone very focused even in bass frequencies. The sinister provides an ultra, amp-like distortion that easily reaches rich harmonics. With the Synister’s full tone stack, players can quickly sculpt their own metal tone; from brown sound to extreme modern metal tones the Synister has it all within reach.
